style: cel-shaded toon game art, thick dark outline, neon rim-light glow on cool blue and violet, flat bold shading
notes: One art style repeated inside every prompt. Orientation is declared in words for every mechanical sprite (rule C.8): the container, beacon, spark, mark, hull pip and the three icons are symmetric front views, so code never mirrors them; the wall ledge is the only asymmetric piece and is drawn as a LEFT-wall bracket, which the game flips for the right wall. Nine-sliced pieces (beam, wall panel, decay band, guide ray) are drawn as plain bars with uniform ends so the slice borders in their .meta have flat material to stretch. Sprites are drawn over whatever backdrop the model picks and matted out by the pipeline, so no prompt argues about background colour. There is no coin, prize or currency art anywhere: the only metrics this game shows are sections and height.
